subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The submitted union_id direction is contradicted by the linked issue and closed sibling PR, and the choice changes message-admission behavior where a wrong identity source can suppress or misroute Feishu group messages.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving a stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention-admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this PR as investigation context and replace it only after broader Feishu identity work lands with positive proof.

options.title: Accept Narrow union_id Direction
options.body: Maintainers can deliberately accept the union_id fallback only with explicit proof that it populates and tests for sibling paths.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving a stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention-admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already requested changes on this exact Feishu identity surface.
